نيراق (form XI)
# نَيْرَاقُّ (nayrāqqu) /naj.raːq.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِيرَاقَّ (īrāqqa)
# نَيْرَاقَّ (nayrāqqa) /naj.raːq.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِيرَاقَّ (īrāqqa)
# نَيْرَاقِّ (nayrāqqi) /naj.raːq.qi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِيرَاقَّ (īrāqqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
